metadata.datum: Fujairah Harbour Datum (MSL less 1.8 m), per the port’s published tidal levels
metadata.note: Interpolated from a ~450 m grid, not measured least depths. A charted sounding is the shoalest depth found over a patch; these are not. Anchorage and approaches only. The dredged basin is narrower than one GEBCO cell, so harbour depths are not contoured — the chart states them as dredged areas (15.0 m 2019, 18.0 m 2010) and that is how they should be carried.
metadata.disclaimer: Derived for demonstration. Not for navigation.
